[Discussion] What recent game that's praised for being innovative or even revolutionary will likely be dated within a few years? Or at least is easily improvable?

hmm, you mean games that shook things up at the time but will become obsolete as future games mimic the things that they did well? The only thing that comes to mind is Titanfall. At the time it shook up the FPS formula with a momentum based movement system, and levels that are designed for vertical access, not to mention the increased scale of the titans themselves. Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare took the idea of jetpacks, but it's Call of Duty: Black Ops III that's really taken a leaf out of Titanfall's book in terms of momentum-based movement and vertically-accessible level design. Part of me is a bit miffed that they "copied" Titanfall's formula, but most of me is just happy that even though Titanfall didn't take off in the way it might have, it at least did something to push the genre forward and make other FPS titles rethink movement and level design.
